Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: Sent by the server for every second for which at least one application message is generated; its time is the reference for the nanosecond offsets of every other application message.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Number of seconds since midnight. Midnight will be in terms of the local time for the server (i.e. not UTC).

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate the start and end of the day.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Start or end of day.

Message.Name: Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: Used to disseminate information (e.g. symbol, segment, ISIN, underlying, etc.) on each instrument.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Status
Field.Description: Status of the instrument. This field will contain a space if the instrument is active.

Field.Name: Identification Number
Field.Description: Instrument identification number (e.g. ISIN, CUSIP, etc.)

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the instrument is assigned to.

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Date an instrument expires or matures. This field will contain only spaces if the instrument is not a derivative or fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of the underlying instrument. This field will contain only spaces if the instrument is not a derivative.

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Strike price of an option. The price will be zero if the instrument is not an option.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Call or put. This field will contain a space if the instrument is not an option.

Field.Name: Issuer
Field.Description: Issuer of the instrument. This field will contain all spaces if the instrument is not an equity or fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Issue Date
Field.Description: Date instrument was issued. This field will contain all spaces if the instrument is not a fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Coupon
Field.Description: Rate of interest applied to the face value. This is a percentage field (e.g. 0.05 represents 5%). The price will be zero if the instrument is not a fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Symbol Directory Flags
Field.Description: Instrument flags. The document names this field Flags.

Field.Name: Sub Book Flags
Field.Description: Order books of the instrument. The document names this field Sub Book.

Field.Name: Corporate Action
Field.Description: Pipe separated field. Identifies the type of Corporate Actions applicable on the instrument for the current Trading day.

Field.Name: Issued Quantity
Field.Description: Issued Quantity of the instrument.

Message.Name: Symbol Status Message
Message.Description: Indicates the trading session (e.g. pre-opening, regular trading, etc.) that currently applies to an instrument.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading session that applies to the instrument.

Field.Name: Symbol Status Flags
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. The document names this field Flags.

Field.Name: Halt Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the trading halt. This field will contain only spaces if Trading Status is not "H".

Field.Name: Session Change Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the session change.

Field.Name: New End Time
Field.Description: New session end time specified in terms of local time for server (i.e. not UTC). The field will contain only spaces if Session Change Reason is "0" or "9".

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book the status relates to.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate that an anonymous limit or market order is added to the order book.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Displayed quantity of the order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order.

Field.Name: Add Order Flags
Field.Description: Order flags. The document names this field Flags.

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book of the order.

Field.Name: Settlement Type
Field.Description: Type of settlement. Only valid when Order Book is Block Trade (4).

Field.Name: Interest Rate
Field.Description: Gives the interest rate for a Repo order. Only valid when Order Book is Block Trade (4).

Field.Name: Term
Field.Description: Gives the term of settlement of the 2nd leg of the Repo. Only valid when Order Book is Block Trade (4).

Message.Name: Add Attributed Order Message
Message.Description: Indicates that an attributable limit order is added to the order book. The identity of the submitting firm is included in the message.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Displayed quantity of the order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order.

Field.Name: Attribution
Field.Description: Identity of firm that submitted the order.

Field.Name: Add Attributed Order Flags
Field.Description: Order flags. The document names this field Flags.

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book of the order.

Message.Name: Order Deleted Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate that the remainder of a displayed order is cancelled.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Identifier for the order.

Message.Name: Order Modified Message
Message.Description: Indicates that the displayed quantity or price of a displayed order has been updated, and whether the order has retained or lost its time priority.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Identifier for the order.

Field.Name: New Quantity
Field.Description: New displayed quantity of the order.

Field.Name: New Price
Field.Description: New limit price of the order.

Field.Name: Order Modified Flags
Field.Description: Order flags. The document names this field Flags.

Field.Name: Settlement Type
Field.Description: Type of settlement. Only valid when Order Book is Block Trade (4).

Field.Name: Interest Rate
Field.Description: Gives the interest rate for a Repo order. Only valid when Order Book is Block Trade (4).

Field.Name: Term
Field.Description: Gives the term of settlement of the 2nd leg of the Repo. Only valid when Order Book is Block Trade (4).

Message.Name: Order Book Clear Message
Message.Description: Sent to instruct recipients to remove all orders from the order book for the specified instrument.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book to be cleared.

Field.Name: Book Type
Field.Description: Type of book to be cleared.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Indicates that the displayed portion of an order is fully or partially filled at its displayed price. The executed quantity is included in the message.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Identifier for the order.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity executed.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Buy Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the buy order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: Sell Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the sell order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: LastOptPx
Field.Description: Converted price of the executed volatility of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Converted volatility of the executed price of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying Reference Price
Field.Description: Underlying Reference Price related to converted value calculated upon an options instrument trade execution.

Message.Name: Order Executed With Price Size Message
Message.Description: Sent if a displayed order is fully or partially filled at a price that is different from its displayed price, with an indication of whether the trade should update time and sales and statistics displays.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Identifier for the order.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity executed.

Field.Name: Display Quantity
Field.Description: Displayed quantity of the order after the execution.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Whether the trade should update time and sales and statistics displays.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price at which the order was executed.

Field.Name: Buy Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the buy order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: Sell Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the sell order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: LastOptPx
Field.Description: Converted price of the executed volatility of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Converted volatility of the executed price of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying Reference Price
Field.Description: Underlying Reference Price related to converted value calculated upon an options instrument trade execution.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Sent if the non-displayed portion of an iceberg order or a reserve order is fully or partially filled, or if the negotiated non-disclosed order in the block trade order book is executed.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Executed price.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book of the trade.

Field.Name: Buy Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the buy order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: Sell Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the sell order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: LastOptPx
Field.Description: Converted price of the executed volatility of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Converted volatility of the executed price of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying Reference Price
Field.Description: Underlying Reference Price related to converted value calculated upon an options instrument trade execution.

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: Sent to report details of an auction (e.g. opening, closing, intra-day, etc.).

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity executed in auction.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of auction.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of auction.

Field.Name: LastOptPx
Field.Description: Converted price of the executed volatility of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Converted volatility of the executed price of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying Reference Price
Field.Description: Underlying Reference Price related to converted value calculated upon an options instrument trade execution.

Message.Name: Off Book Trade Message
Message.Description: Sent to report the details of an off-book trade.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Executed price.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Off Book Trade Type
Field.Description: Type of off-book trade.

Field.Name: Trade Time
Field.Description: Time off-book trade was executed. The time is specified in terms of the local time for the server (i.e. not UTC).

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Date off-book trade was executed.

Field.Name: LastOptPx
Field.Description: Converted price of the executed volatility of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Converted volatility of the executed price of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying Reference Price
Field.Description: Underlying Reference Price related to converted value calculated upon an options instrument trade execution.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate that a previously reported trade is cancelled.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the cancelled trade.

Field.Name: Trade Type
Field.Description: On-book or off-book trade.

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Sent to report the correction of the executed quantity of a trade.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol of the trade.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The original executed price (price of a trade cannot be amended).

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: New executed quantity of the trade.

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book of the trade.

Field.Name: Buy Firm
Field.Description: Gives the broker ID who submitted the buy order.

Field.Name: Sell Firm
Field.Description: Gives the broker ID who submitted the sell order.

Message.Name: Recovery Trade Message
Message.Description: Sent on the Snapshot channel to retransmit the trades published on the Real-Time channel.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Executed price.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of auction. This field will contain a space if the trade is not an auction trade.

Field.Name: Off Book Trade Type
Field.Description: Type of off-book trade. This field will contain only spaces for on-book trades.

Field.Name: Trade Time
Field.Description: Time trade was executed. The time is specified in terms of the local time for the server (i.e. not UTC).

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Date the off-book trade was executed. This field will contain only spaces for on-book trades.

Field.Name: Action Type
Field.Description: Action on the trade.

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book of the trade.

Field.Name: Buy Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the buy order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: Sell Firm
Field.Description: Identifier of the firm which submitted the sell order. Required only if the 'Publish Firms' is enabled for the order book in which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: LastOptPx
Field.Description: Converted price of the executed volatility of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Converted volatility of the executed price of the options instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying Reference Price
Field.Description: Underlying Reference Price related to converted value calculated upon an options instrument trade execution.

Field.Name: Auction Trade Type
Field.Description: Denotes the type of the auction trade being disseminated. For regular trades this field will be unset.

Message.Name: Auction Info Message
Message.Description: Indicative auction information for an instrument; the document labels the message type Indicative Auction Info.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Paired Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity that will be matched at the indicative price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity that is eligible to be matched at the indicative price but will not be matched.

Field.Name: Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: Direction of the imbalance.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Indicative auction price.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of auction.

Message.Name: Statistics Message
Message.Description: Sent to disseminate the opening, closing and previous closing prices of an instrument.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Statistic Type
Field.Description: Type of statistic.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Opening or closing price.

Field.Name: Open Close Indicator
Field.Description: How the price was determined.

Field.Name: SubBook
Field.Description: Order book of the statistic.

Message.Name: Extended Statistics Message
Message.Description: Sent to disseminate the high, low, VWAP, volume, turnover and other statistics of an instrument for a sub book.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: High Price
Field.Description: High price for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Field.Name: Low Price
Field.Description: Low price for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Field.Name: VWAP
Field.Description: VWAP for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Volume for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn. The document types the field as an unsigned integer.

Field.Name: Turnover
Field.Description: Turnover for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Field.Name: Trades
Field.Description: Number of trades for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn. The document types the field as an unsigned integer.

Field.Name: Reserved 8
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Sub Book
Field.Description: Order book of the statistics.

Field.Name: Notional Exposure
Field.Description: Notional exposure related to the options trade executions.

Field.Name: Notional Delta Exposure
Field.Description: Notional exposure updated by the delta of the option based on trade executions.

Field.Name: Daily Foreign Buy Value
Field.Description: Total foreign buy trade value for the day for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Field.Name: Daily Foreign Sell Value
Field.Description: Total foreign sell trade value for the day for the sub book. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Field.Name: Market Capitalization
Field.Description: Market Capitalization of the instrument. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Message.Name: Consolidated Statistics Message
Message.Description: Sent to disseminate the volume, turnover and trades of a market, sector or instrument type.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Statistics Type
Field.Description: Level the statistics relate to.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Unique identifier of market or sector.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Traded volume for the market or sector.

Field.Name: Turnover
Field.Description: Turnover of the market or sector.

Field.Name: Trades
Field.Description: Number of trades for market or sector.

Field.Name: Daily Foreign Buy Value
Field.Description: Total foreign buy trade value for the day for the market, sector or instrument type.

Field.Name: Daily Foreign Sell Value
Field.Description: Total foreign sell trade value for the day for the market, sector or instrument type.

Field.Name: Market Capitalization
Field.Description: Market Capitalization of the Market or Sector. Will be set to a negative value if the value is not set or withdrawn.

Message.Name: Index Message
Message.Description: Sent to disseminate the value of an index.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the index.

Field.Name: Index Value
Field.Description: Index value.

Field.Name: Update Type
Field.Description: Type of index value.

Field.Name: Perctg Diff From Closing
Field.Description: Percentage difference of the current Index value compared to the Previous Closing index value. This will be set to 0 when the Index Type is Previous Close (2); the document means Update Type.

Message.Name: AON Info Message
Message.Description: Sent to disseminate the details of an All or None auction.

Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument's symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: AON Auction Price.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the auction.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity being auctioned.

Field.Name: AON Status
Field.Description: Status of the auction.

Field.Name: Date
Field.Description: Date the auction is being held. This field will contain only spaces if the instrument contains an AON Status of 'Inactive' or 'Cancelled'.

Message.Name: News Message
Message.Description: Sent to disseminate an announcement.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds offset from the last Time message.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Time the announcement was published. The time is specified in terms of the local time for the server (i.e. not UTC).

Field.Name: Urgency
Field.Description: Urgency of the announcement.

Field.Name: Headline

Field.Name: Underlyings
Field.Description: Pipe separated list of symbols of the underlyings announcement relates to.

Field.Name: Update Price Point Flags
Field.Description: Price point flags. The document names this field Flags.

Field.Name: Reserved 1

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the price point.

Field.Name: Price Level
Field.Description: Price Level that needs to be deleted.
